font.description: The font family to use for rendering NFO files. Terminus is the standard recommended font for CP437 art.

encoding.description: The character encoding of the NFO files to be displayed. CP437 is the standard IBM PC character set used in classic NFOs.

hyperlinks.description: Whether to enable clickable hyperlink detection within NFO files.

auto_resize.description: Whether to automatically resize the viewer window to fit the dimensions of the NFO file.
